scoring_justification: T1 infeasible as no raw field profiles or intermediate numeric artifacts that permit recomputing F_total from first principles; only the final energy CSV is provided. Structural checks on energy landscape (global minima location, relative ordering of y-walls vs x-walls, symmetry) are robust verifications of the paper's main claim.

outputs.description: Domain wall free energy per unit volume for LiNbO₃ and LiTaO₃ at 12 wall orientations (0° to 330° in 30° steps). Validates the structural property that y-walls are the global energy minima.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker verifies that the six global minima of F_total occur at θ = 0°,60°,120°,180°,240°,300° (y-wall normals), that the average F_total at these angles is lower than the average at the x-wall normals (30°,90°,…,330°), and that symmetry-related values are equal within a tolerance.

steps.description: Structural verification of domain wall energy landscape: (1) six global minima at y‑wall normals (0°,60°,120°,180°,240°,300°); (2) average F_total over y‑walls lower than over x‑walls; (3) symmetry among y‑wall energies ≤ 2%; (4) symmetry among x‑wall energies ≤ 2%.
